summary: In a routine 8-K, TPG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund declared June 2026 distributions of $0.2000 per share across Class I, S, and D common shares, payable July 29, 2026, to holders of record June 30, 2026. The filing also disclosed May 31, 2026 NAV of $25.2108 per share, aggregate NAV of $2.6 billion, and the ongoing continuous public offering of up to $5.0 billion in shares, with total consideration of $2,744.5 million sold through June 1, 2026. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, spin-off, restructuring) is present; this is a standard monthly disclosure of distributions, NAV, and offering status. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are included.
